manual.jerrycan.line2: {0}Jerrycans are simple metal containers used to carry fluids. They can store up to 10 buckets and can pour that fluid into the world as well as into machines.{1}
manual.jerrycan.line3: Jerrycans cannot be used to pick up fluids from the world, but can be refilled from tanks such as {0}barrels{1} or {2}large tanks{3}.{4}
manual.jerrycan.line4: Additionally, they can be used to refill fluid-consuming items like the {0}Mining Drill{1} by placing the jerrycan and the tool together in a crafting grid.
